scientific_limitations_integrity: Exact statement only for independent uniform 3-of-4 subsets, equicorrelated unit-row Gram matrices, and the BRUS algorithm at absorbed stepsize 1. The result sharpens the sufficiency window of the original mean-square convergence theorem but does not contradict it. The equivalent weighted RB-SKM alternative has relaxation 3, not the pseudoinverse Algorithm 1 of that other paper. Finite checker tests supplement an analytic proof; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Sharp mean-square frontier for three-row block-row uniform sampling beyond its safe stepsize bound
